title: Verifier Acceptance and Check Validity
statement: For every $m\in\mathbb{N}$, seed $s\in\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}\sqcup\mathrm{Fin}(m)$, Boolean input word $w$ of length $m+2$, and Boolean proof word $q$ of length $m+1$, the verifier of the odd-weight partial-sum PCPP system accepts the combined input and proof on seed $s$ if and only if the partial sum check specified by $s$ holds for $w$ and $q$.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a Boolean word of length $m+2$
$q$ is a Boolean proof word of length $m+1$
